title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20

ai_review.summary: Poorly pitched soundboard capture but an enjoyable acoustic set highlighted by a tasty Truckin'
ai_review.review: The recording suffers from a noticeable half‑tone pitch error and is generally considered inferior to the Sirmick remaster, making the audio quality subpar. On the upside, listeners praise the acoustic portion of the show, especially the acoustic rendition of "Truckin'" and Bob Weir’s vocal delivery. Overall the performance shines in the acoustic set while the technical flaws dominate the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Two of three reviews criticize the recording (pitch issues, inferior sound) while only one praises the performance; the poor technical quality outweighs the decent acoustic set.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Half‑tone low pitch throughout, considered worse than the Sirmick remaster; overall clarity and fidelity are lacking.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set described as tasty with good flow; no major issues noted beyond the technical pitch problem.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bobby) praised for grinding the lyrics on acoustic Truckin'
